source_message.text:
Correct. Sensors and power-management circuitry stay on the other boards; the main board contains:

\- ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8 module
\- INA219 current monitor measuring the 3.3V rail
\- USB-C programming connector plus an LDO for standalone operation
\- All JST connectors for the power board, sensor board, display, PIR, touch inputs, LEDs, buttons, and reset
\- Supporting components including decoupling capacitors, pull-ups, series resistors, Schottky diodes, and a BOOT button

routing_warnings.description: This placement request concerns ESP32 decoupling on the later single integrated board, not the earlier main board.
This message concerns AXP2101 and MT3608 decoupling placement on the integrated board.
The assessment that the ESP32 capacitors can remain unchanged addresses the integrated-board ESP32 decoupling discussion.
The client's instruction to leave the capacitors unchanged resolves the integrated-board ESP32 decoupling request.
